Use case: stylized-concept. World 4 CORAL COAST low-poly 2.5D platformer environment production art. Match the supplied FIVE REALMS map's fourth region: warm ivory limestone islands, pale sand caps, teal ocean, green palms, salmon pink and peach coral, wooden jetties/rope bridges, weathered wreck and pastel shell palace. Charming chunky low-poly volumes suitable for Blender, clear silhouettes, flat cel-like shading, restrained moderate saturation, simple material zones, soft sunny lighting. No photoreal microtexture, no excessive bloom, no text except required sheet labels. Consistent original game asset family.
Create a wide landscape full-stage concept illustration. Reference is the world identity and art direction ONLY, not a map to reproduce. Near-side-on 2.5D adventure traverse moving left to right, slight downward camera shows volume depth. Left palm beach on sand-topped limestone ledges, center staggered horizontal island platforms above shallow turquoise water and a short wooden jetty/rope bridge, a tilted old shipwreck hull in midground, right a shell palace with large spiral conch roof and small scallop turrets on raised coastal rock. Farther layers: low islets, sea stacks, thick natural stone arch, coral reef ridge, distant islands. Every terrain block has full 3D sides. Play path ABOVE water, no underwater swimming sequence. Foreground props: branching coral with 3 chunky branches, rounded brain-coral lumps, broad-leaf shore plants, a palm, shells, a rope-bound crate, barrel, upright anchor, short navigation lantern post, rope bollards, a blue pennant. Small crab and hermit crab as scale creatures. Pearl checkpoint beacon near a coral pressure plate, open shell goal arch by palace. Ocean and sparse white foam below footpath; sand surface readable and level. No UI, no logo, no words. Proposed environment art composition, not measured jump layout.

M01 TIDE CRAB: orange squat crab, exactly EIGHT walking legs (four symmetric pairs) plus TWO large separate pincers, two eyestalks; front and back clearly show all eight small walking legs, side can overlap; action sidestep claw snap. M02 CONCH HERMIT: peach hermit crab with a large cream-and-orange spiral conch shell, TWO front pincers and FOUR exposed walking legs (two pairs), tiny rear limbs stay concealed in shell; action withdraw into shell. Tiny isolated assembly diagrams at right: shell/body, fins, bell/tentacles. Charming threats with distinct silhouettes, no realistic marine textures, no gore, no extra limbs, no hidden fingers. IDs and names only, no complex prose.
